scripts.db:setup: bash scripts/start-local-postgres.sh && npm run db:setup -w api
scripts.sync: bash scripts/sync-github.sh && npm install && npm run db:setup && npm run codegen -w web
scripts.sync:all: npm run sync && npm run sync:aws
scripts.dev:web:aws: bash -c 'set -a; [ -f apps/web/.env.aws ] && . apps/web/.env.aws; set +a; npm run dev -w web'
scripts.dev: bash scripts/free-dev-ports.sh && concurrently -n api,web,docs -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "bash scripts/wait-api-and-dev-web.sh" "npm run dev -w docs"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.infra:synth: npm run build -w web && npm run infra:install && npm run synth --prefix infra
scripts.infra:deploy: npm run build -w web && npm run infra:install && npm run deploy --prefix infra
